title: All-white table with no row shading; toolbar controls in the fixed order
refs: SV-8655 (TU spec v5 2026-07-29 S8-R1; S8-R2; S8-R3 — toolbar order rewritten: Column Selection inserted after the three-dot menu,and the date-range picker now precedes the technician filter)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with rows loaded, in light mode.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the column headers and the data rows' backgrounds.
2. Read the toolbar controls left to right.
3. Look for the expand/collapse-all control's position.
custom_expected:
1. The report uses an all-white table: white column headers and white data cells, with NO alternating row shading.
2. The toolbar controls run, left to right: the three-dot download menu, the Column Selection control, the date-range picker, the technician filter, and the Location filter (rightmost).
3. The expand/collapse-all control is NOT a toolbar control - it lives in the table header (in the Technician column).
